extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: A simple plugin to link new notes to the daily note.
motivation: It is useful for workflows where you want to capture quick notes without naming friction while keeping them connected to your daily log.
problem: The difficulty in capturing quick, temporary notes while ensuring they are logged and linked to the current day's summary.
summary: Creates unique timestamped notes and automatically appends a link to the corresponding note in the daily note.
